title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_zulajka_opent_haar_ogen_by_guzel_jachina_0zzc7 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_zulajka_opent_haar_ogen_by_guzel_jachina_0zzc7' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package potentially grants full control to an attacker, risking exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the system. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised machine is strongly advised.
